items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesized findings on arm exercise training for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), confirming its role in pulmonary rehabilitation, although the specific level of evidence requires careful consideration of the included studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述强化了上肢运动训练作为 COPD 肺康复重要组成部分的证据，特别是其对改善呼吸困难、肌肉耐力及生活质量的益处。将其纳入你的康复方案是符合证据的。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的上肢运动训练：系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述综合了关于慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者上肢运动训练的发现，证实了其在肺康复中的作用，尽管具体的证据水平需要仔细考量纳入研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strengthens the evidence for arm exercise training as a vital component of pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD, particularly its benefits for dyspnea, muscle endurance, and quality of life. Incorporating it into your rehabilitation protocols is evidence-based.
items.limitation: 该综述的局限性在于其基于现有系统综述和荟萃分析，可能未能捕获最新发表的原始研究，且评估的效应量和患者异质性仍需关注。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this umbrella review is that it relies on existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses, potentially missing the most recently published primary studies, and the evaluated effect sizes and patient heterogeneity still warrant attention.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper argues that physiotherapy is entering a post-professional era, characterized by the progressive marginalization of practitioners due to late-stage capitalism, the unbundling of professional claims, and digitally mediated technological disruption.
items.curatedReason: 物理治疗的“后专业时代”可能已经到来，数字化解构和资本逻辑正在稀释专业自主性。你需要警惕这个趋势，并思考如何在这种结构性变迁中，重新定义和巩固物理治疗的专业价值，而不是被动边缘化。
items.titleZh: 当算法不关心：物理治疗与后专业转型
items.summaryZh: 本文认为，物理治疗正进入一个后专业时代，其特点是由于晚期资本主义、专业主张的解绑以及数字技术颠覆，物理治疗师在协调和提供护理方面的边缘化日益加剧。
items.curatedReasonEn: The 'post-professional era' for physiotherapy may be here. Digital unbundling and capitalist logic are diluting professional autonomy. You need to be aware of this trend and consider how to redefine and consolidate physiotherapy's professional value amidst these structural changes, rather than being passively marginalized.

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial involving 30 pediatric oncohematological patients (8-17 years) found that a therapeutic exercise program during hospitalization may improve quality of life, muscle strength, fatigue, and functional capacity compared to minimal active physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 本项试点 RCT 提示，住院期间的早期运动干预可能改善儿童肿瘤患者的功能和生活质量。将其纳入你的早期康复方案，但需注意其样本量较小。
items.titleZh: 住院期间儿科肿瘤血液病患者的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 30 名 8-17 岁儿科肿瘤血液病患者的随机临床试验显示，住院期间的治疗性运动方案与最小限度的主动物理治疗相比，可能改善生活质量、肌肉力量、疲劳和功能能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that early in-hospital therapeutic exercise may improve functional capacity and quality of life in pediatric oncohematological patients. Consider incorporating it into your early rehabilitation protocols, but note the small sample size.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且随访期短，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and short follow-up, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: The 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS), an activity-based patient-reported outcome measure (PROM) using a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format, was developed and psychometrically validated in a multicenter study of 415 patients to identify the first threshold of difficulty during daily activities.
items.curatedReason: SPAS 量表提供了一种新颖的二分法评估思路，它不是在测量疼痛程度，而是通过 12 个日常活动，直接判断患者首次出现困难的阈值。这提示我们，未来在评估肩关节功能时，可以考虑这种更聚焦于功能障碍起始点的测量方式。
items.titleZh: 肩关节问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心研究开发并验证了 12 项肩关节问题评估量表 (SPAS)，该量表是一种基于活动的患者报告结局测量工具，采用分级是/否格式，旨在识别日常活动中的首个难度阈值；研究纳入 415 名患者进行心理测量学测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SPAS offers a novel dichotomous assessment approach; it identifies the first threshold of difficulty in 12 daily activities, rather than measuring pain intensity. This suggests that future shoulder function assessments could benefit from this method, which focuses on the onset of functional limitations.
items.limitation: 研究样本以门诊患者为主，对住院或特定亚群患者的适用性需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study sample primarily consisted of outpatient individuals; its applicability to inpatient or specific patient subgroups requires further validation.

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: This patient-focused case report describes a 64-year-old male who developed neuralgic amyotrophy with severe periscapular pain and marked weakness eight days post-arthroscopic rotator cuff repair, showing slow but substantial functional recovery after prolonged progressive physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这例报告提醒你，臂丛神经炎（NA）是肩袖修复术后一种罕见但可能致残的并发症，应警惕其异常疼痛和无力症状，早期识别有助于优化康复路径。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后臂丛神经炎：一例患者的经历
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 64 岁男性在关节镜肩袖修复术后 8 天出现臂丛神经炎，表现为严重的肩胛周疼痛和明显无力；经过长时间渐进式物理治疗，患者功能恢复缓慢但显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This report reminds you that neuralgic amyotrophy (NA) is a rare but potentially debilitating complication following rotator cuff repair. Be vigilant for its unusual pain and weakness symptoms, as early identification can optimize rehabilitation pathways.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，结论的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and the generalizability of its conclusions is limited.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report describes an integrated rehabilitation approach incorporating aquatic therapy for a 51-year-old woman 4 weeks post-PCL avulsion injury reconstruction, aiming to facilitate early functional recovery by minimizing joint loading.
items.curatedReason: 整合水疗的康复方案，在 PCL 重建术后早期为患者提供了一个低负荷环境，可能有助于促进功能恢复并减少移植物应力，为你的 PCL 术后康复方案提供了新的思路。
items.titleZh: PCL 重建术后整合水疗的康复案例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告描述了一名 51 岁女性在右侧 PCL 撕脱伤重建术后 4 周采用整合水疗的康复方案，旨在通过减少关节负荷促进早期功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating aquatic therapy into rehabilitation protocols can provide a low-load environment for patients in the early stages post-PCL reconstruction. This may help promote functional recovery and reduce graft stress, offering a new approach to your PCL post-operative rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，其观察结果需要通过更高质量的研究来验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and its observations require validation through higher-quality studies.

items.title: Clinical and neurophysiological determinants of response to contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation after stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs (up to July 2026) found that contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) effectively improves post-stroke upper-limb function, with treatment effects modulated by baseline motor impairment and corticospinal tract integrity.
items.curatedReason: 对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激（LF-rTMS）确实能改善卒中后上肢功能，这篇系统综述再次确认了这一点。但请注意，它的疗效受到患者基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性的影响，这意味着在筛选患者和调整方案时，你需要把这些因素考虑进去。
items.titleZh: 卒中后对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激反应的临床和神经生理学决定因素：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 RCT 的系统综述和荟萃分析（截至 2026 年 7 月）发现，对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激（LF-rTMS）可有效改善卒中后上肢功能，其治疗效果受基线运动障碍和皮质脊髓束完整性的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) does improve post-stroke upper-limb function, and this systematic review reinforces that. However, be mindful that its efficacy is modulated by baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity, so factor these into your patient screening and treatment planning.
items.limitation: 尽管是系统综述和荟萃分析，但纳入的原始研究在刺激参数和康复方案上仍可能存在异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review and meta-analysis, heterogeneity in stimulation parameters and rehabilitation protocols among included original studies may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: This cross-sectional observational study (N=20) found that finger-worn accelerometers are a valid and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了指戴式加速度计在测量卒中幸存者上肢表现方面的初步验证，表明其可能是腕戴式设备的有效替代。这为你在临床中选择可穿戴设备进行客观评估提供了新的选项，尤其是在关注精细手功能恢复时。
items.titleZh: 不只是手臂运动：指戴式加速度计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界肢体表现方面是腕戴式加速度计的有效且敏感的替代品
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面观察研究（N=20）发现，指戴式加速度计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢表现方面，是腕戴式加速度计的有效且敏感的替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides preliminary validation for finger-worn accelerometers in measuring upper-limb performance in stroke survivors, suggesting they could be a valid alternative to wrist-worn devices. This offers a new option for selecting wearable devices for objective assessment in your clinical practice, especially when focusing on fine hand function recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察设计，样本量相对较小（20 名参与者），且主要在实验室和自由生活环境进行，可能无法完全捕捉到所有真实世界的使用情境。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study has a relatively small sample size (20 participants) and was conducted primarily in laboratory and free-living environments, which may not capture all real-world usage scenarios.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: This exploratory case series (N=8) from the MACHINE trial investigated cardiovascular and autonomic responses to body weight-supported treadmill training combined with active or sham transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation in individuals with chronic, motor-complete spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究揭示了经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动疗法对慢性脊髓损伤患者心血管和自主神经功能的潜在影响。这提示了在脊髓损伤康复中整合自主神经调节策略的可能性。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激联合活动疗法的心血管和自主神经反应：来自 MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: MACHINE 试验的这项探索性病例系列研究（N=8）调查了慢性完全性脊髓损伤患者体重支持跑步机训练结合主动或假性经皮脊髓电刺激后的心血管和自主神经反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the potential impact of transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy on cardiovascular and autonomic functions in individuals with chronic spinal cord injury. This suggests the possibility of integrating autonomic regulation strategies in spinal cord injury rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项来自随机对照试验的探索性病例系列研究，样本量极小（8 名参与者），结果需要进一步的大规模随机对照试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory case series from a randomized controlled trial with a very small sample size (8 participants), and the results require validation through larger randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Relationship Between Physiological Mirror Activity and Corticomuscular Coherence During a Finger Dexterity Task Among Healthy Young and Older Adults
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 31 young and 24 older adults found that physiological mirror activity (pMA) is associated with gamma-band corticomuscular coherence (CMC) during finger dexterity tasks, with older adults showing increased pMA.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性观察研究揭示了生理镜像活动与皮层-肌肉协同性之间的神经生理学关联，有助于你理解其背后的神经机制，尤其是在评估老年患者精细运动功能和制定干预方案时，提供了一个新的视角。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻与老年人手指灵巧任务中生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉协同性的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究纳入了 31 名年轻成年人和 24 名老年成年人，发现生理镜像活动（pMA）与手指灵巧任务中的伽马波段皮层肌肉协同性（CMC）相关，其中老年人表现出更高的 pMA。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory observational study uncovers neurophysiological links between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence, deepening your understanding of underlying neural mechanisms. This offers a new perspective, especially when assessing fine motor function in older adults and designing interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，样本量有限，且未探讨两者在康复干预后的纵向变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study has a limited sample size and does not explore longitudinal changes in the relationship following rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary examines how various care process factors, such as timing, point of entry, care pathway design, and payment models, shape physical therapist management of low back pain and influence patient outcomes independently of specific treatments.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评为你清晰勾勒了腰痛患者管理中，除了具体治疗手段外，还有哪些“流程因素”会显著影响临床结局。它提醒你除了关注疗效，还要关注服务设计的每一个环节。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理流程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了包括治疗时机、初始提供者类型、护理路径设计和支付模式在内的多种护理流程因素，如何在不依赖于具体治疗方法的情况下，塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理并影响患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary clearly outlines how "care process factors," beyond specific treatment interventions, significantly influence clinical outcomes in low back pain management. It reminds you to consider every aspect of service design in addition to treatment efficacy.
items.limitation: 述评的证据等级较低，主要基于现有文献的综合分析和专家观点。
items.limitationEn: As a commentary, the evidence level is lower, primarily based on synthesis of existing literature and expert opinions.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: A Phase I single-arm repeated-measures study observed changes in outcome following an 8-week, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation intervention for motor recovery in people with chronic stroke (≥12 months post-stroke) and persistent motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 这项单臂研究提示，多技术整合的强化康复方案对慢性卒中患者的运动功能改善有潜力。这支持了在长期康复中采用综合性、技术辅助的干预模式。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的强化多技术康复方案：一项 I 期单臂重复测量研究的结果
items.summaryZh: 一项 I 期单臂重复测量研究观察了慢性卒中（发病至少 12 个月）且持续存在运动障碍的患者，在参与为期 8 周的、基于小组的、多技术整合康复干预后，其功能结局的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-arm study suggests that an intensive, multi-technology integrated rehabilitation program holds promise for improving motor function in chronic stroke survivors. This supports the use of comprehensive, technology-assisted intervention models in long-term rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂设计，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single-arm design, lacking a control group, which prevents ruling out placebo effects or natural recovery impacting the outcomes.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise-based prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: This systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs compared the effectiveness of different exercise modalities for prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty (TKA), finding high-intensity resistance training and aerobic exercise to be potentially more effective than conventional interventions.
items.curatedReason: 面对全膝关节置换术（TKA）术前康复，你的策略应更倾向于高强度抗阻训练或有氧运动。这项系统综述和网络 Meta 分析显示，它们可能比传统干预更有效，为你的运动处方提供了更强的支持。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术前基于运动的康复训练的比较有效性：随机对照试验的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 RCT 的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析比较了全膝关节置换术（TKA）前不同运动模式康复训练的有效性，发现高强度抗阻训练和有氧运动可能比传统干预更有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: For TKA prehabilitation, your strategy should lean towards high-intensity resistance training or aerobic exercise. This systematic review and network meta-analysis suggests they may be more effective than conventional interventions, offering stronger support for your exercise prescriptions.
items.limitation: 研究可能存在纳入研究异质性问题，且不同运动模式的剂量和方案细节可能影响结果解释。
items.limitationEn: The study may suffer from heterogeneity among included studies, and differences in dose and protocol details of various exercise modalities could affect interpretation of results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of different aerobic exercise intensities on exercise capacity, quality of life and mortality in individuals with coronary artery disease: systematic review and network meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and network meta-analysis investigated the comparative effectiveness of different aerobic exercise intensities in adults with coronary artery disease (CAD) on exercise capacity, quality of life, and mortality, suggesting varying benefits across intensities.
items.curatedReason: 对于冠状动脉疾病（CAD）患者，你在制定有氧运动处方时，应考虑不同强度带来的差异化益处。这项系统综述提示，例如，高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在改善运动能力方面可能表现更优，而其他强度或许在生活质量或死亡率上有其独特优势。
items.titleZh: 不同有氧运动强度对冠状动脉疾病患者运动能力、生活质量和死亡率的影响：系统综述和网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和网络 Meta 分析调查了不同有氧运动强度对冠状动脉疾病（CAD）成年患者运动能力、生活质量和死亡率的比较有效性，提示不同强度有不同的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For CAD patients, when prescribing aerobic exercise, you should consider the differentiated benefits of varying intensities. This systematic review suggests, for instance, that HIIT may be superior in improving exercise capacity, while other intensities might offer unique advantages for quality of life or mortality.
items.limitation: 不同运动强度的干预方案异质性可能较大，且多数研究关注的是短期结局。
items.limitationEn: Intervention protocols for different exercise intensities may have significant heterogeneity, and most studies focus on short-term outcomes.

items.title: Beyond Conventional Therapy in Parkinson's Disease Patients: The Impact of Visual Feedback Training on Balance and Trunk Control - A Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-week program combining conventional physiotherapy with visual-feedback balance and trunk-control training improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in 21 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn and Yahr stages 1-3).
items.curatedReason: 视觉反馈训练平台配合传统物理治疗，可显著改善帕金森病患者的平衡、步态和躯干控制。将视觉反馈技术整合到你的康复方案中，为这类患者提供额外支持。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者的视觉反馈训练：对平衡和躯干控制的影响——一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 周、结合传统物理治疗和视觉反馈平衡与躯干控制训练的项目，改善了 21 名帕金森病（Hoehn-Yahr 1-3 期）患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Visual feedback training platforms combined with conventional physiotherapy significantly improve balance, gait, and trunk control in Parkinson's disease patients. Consider integrating visual feedback technology into your rehabilitation protocols for added support in this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列研究，缺乏随机对照组，可能存在混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective cohort study lacking a randomized control group, which may introduce confounding factors.

items.title: Visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes
items.summary: This study found that visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation (SmO2) from portable near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes, suggesting SmO2 breakpoints are not a reliable substitute for delineating exercise intensity domains.
items.curatedReason: 请注意，在评估国家级铁人三项运动员的运动强度时，SmO2 的拐点不能简单替代通气阈值。这项研究表明两者不等同，若你仅依赖 SmO2，可能会导致训练强度划分不准确。
items.titleZh: 国家级铁人三项运动员肌肉氧饱和度的目视识别拐点与通气阈值不等同
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，便携式近红外光谱（NIRS）观察到的肌肉氧饱和度（SmO2）目视识别拐点与国家级铁人三项运动员的通气阈值不等同，提示 SmO2 拐点不是划分运动强度区域的可靠替代指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: Be aware that SmO2 breakpoints are not simply interchangeable with ventilatory thresholds when assessing exercise intensity in national-level triathletes. This study indicates they are not equivalent; relying solely on SmO2 may lead to inaccurate training intensity demarcation.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为国家级铁人三项运动员，结果外推至其他人群或运动项目时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were national-level triathletes only, so results should be generalized to other populations or sports with caution.

items.title: Measurement properties of a 300-m community-based walking test incorporating environmental walking demands in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.summary: A study evaluated the measurement properties of a 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) in 26 individuals with subacute stroke, finding strong test-retest reliability (ICC 2,1) in both forward and reverse directions.
items.curatedReason: 这个 300 米社区步行测试的测量学特性很扎实，可以作为亚急性卒中患者评估步态耐力的一个补充工具，尤其是在模拟真实环境挑战方面有优势。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者 300 米社区步行测试测量学特性研究，融入环境步行需求
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了 26 名亚急性卒中患者的 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）的测量学特性，结果显示其在正向和反向均具有很强的重测信度（ICC 2,1）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The robust psychometric properties of this 300-m Community-Based Walking Test make it a valuable supplementary tool for assessing gait endurance in subacute stroke patients, particularly for its ability to simulate real-world environmental walking demands.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（26人），可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (26 individuals) may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Efficacy of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation in Acute Ischemic Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Stimulation Montages and Timing.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 RCTs (N=419) found that active tDCS significantly reduced neurological deficits (WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001) compared to sham stimulation in acute ischemic stroke, but did not significantly improve motor function.
items.curatedReason: 对于急性缺血性卒中，经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 在减少神经功能缺损方面显示出显著益处，这一结果支持其作为急性期辅助干预手段的潜力。但对运动功能改善的效应仍需更多研究。在你考虑在急性卒中患者中使用 tDCS 时，可参考此证据。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激在急性缺血性卒中中的疗效：刺激模式与时机的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 项 RCT（N=419）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，在急性缺血性卒中中，主动经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 相比假刺激显著减少了神经功能缺损 (WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001)，但对运动功能没有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) shows significant benefits in reducing neurological deficits in acute ischemic stroke, supporting its potential as an adjunctive intervention during the acute phase. However, its effect on motor function improvement requires further research. Consider this evidence when evaluating tDCS for acute stroke patients.
items.limitation: 研究未显著改善上肢和下肢运动功能，且纳入研究数量和样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: The study did not significantly improve upper and lower limb motor function, and the number of included studies and sample sizes were relatively small.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Post-stroke smoking and mental health burden: sex-specific analysis of NHIS 2019-2023.
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of NHIS 2019-2023 data (N=150,220 adults) revealed significant associations between stroke history, mental health burden, and smoking, highlighting the need for integrated behavioral health in stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后吸烟和精神健康问题（抑郁/焦虑）在康复患者中普遍存在，且与康复依从性和预后直接相关。这份分析强调了将这些行为健康因素整合到常规卒中康复护理中的必要性。
items.titleZh: 卒中后吸烟与精神健康负担：NHIS 2019-2023 的性别特异性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 2019-2023 年 NHIS 数据的横断面分析（N=150,220 名成人）显示，卒中史、精神健康负担和吸烟之间存在显著关联，强调了卒中康复中整合行为健康干预的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke smoking and mental health burdens (depression/anxiety) are prevalent and directly impact rehabilitation engagement and outcomes. This analysis underscores the necessity of integrating these behavioral health factors into routine stroke rehabilitation care.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面分析，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional analysis, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Inspiratory Strength Training in Pediatric Cardiac Critical Care: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found inspiratory strength training to be feasible and safe in children with congenital heart disease in a pediatric cardiac intensive care unit.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，对于心脏重症监护病房的儿童，吸气肌力量训练是可行且安全的。虽然证据等级不高，但它为未来更大规模的儿科心肺康复研究提供了重要铺垫。
items.titleZh: 儿科心脏重症监护中吸气肌力量训练：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究评估了吸气肌力量训练在儿科心脏重症监护室中先天性心脏病儿童的可行性、安全性和生理反应，发现该训练可行且安全。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study indicates that inspiratory strength training is feasible and safe for children in cardiac critical care. While the evidence level is not high, it lays important groundwork for future larger-scale pediatric cardiopulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，缺乏对照组，且主要关注可行性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study lacking a control group and primarily focused on feasibility and safety.

items.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic SCI, identifying grade-specific predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这个基于大样本数据集开发的临床预测规则，能根据 ASIA 损伤分级为创伤性脊髓损伤患者提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后，对于制定康复计划和管理患者期望很有价值。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立行走的等级特异性临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用全国脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）开发了一个临床预测规则，旨在预测创伤性脊髓损伤患者一年后的独立行走能力，并识别了与损伤等级相关的预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule, developed using a large dataset, provides differentiated prognosis for independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury based on ASIA Impairment Scale grades, valuable for rehabilitation planning and managing patient expectations.
items.limitation: 预测变量的选择和机器学习模型建立的细节需进一步公开，以评估其稳健性和可解释性。
items.limitationEn: Further details on the selection of predictive variables and the establishment of machine learning models are needed to assess robustness and interpretability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Analysis of Home-Based Rehabilitation Robotics: Lessons Learned from Nationwide Direct-to-Consumer Deployment.
items.summary: An analysis discusses the lessons learned from nationwide direct-to-consumer deployment of home-based rehabilitation robotics for stroke survivors, highlighting potential workforce multipliers for neurorehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇分析总结了美国居家康复机器人部署的经验教训，对评估新技术在卒中康复中的潜力、挑战和扩大规模至关重要。
items.titleZh: 居家康复机器人分析：全国性消费者直达部署的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 一项分析讨论了美国卒中幸存者居家康复机器人在全国范围内直接面向消费者部署的经验教训，强调了其在神经康复中作为劳动力乘数的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis summarizes lessons learned from home-based rehabilitation robotics deployment in the US, crucial for evaluating the potential, challenges, and scalability of new technologies in stroke rehabilitation.

items.title: Have conflicts of interest in manual therapy trials for low back pain been transparent? A meta-epidemiological review.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological review identified and compared study-disclosed conflicts of interest with externally discovered ones in manual therapy trials for low back pain published between 2000 and 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述揭示了手动疗法试验中利益冲突披露的潜在不足，提醒我们在评估相关研究证据时需对透明度保持警惕。
items.titleZh: 腰痛手动疗法试验中的利益冲突披露是否透明？一项荟萃流行病学综述
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃流行病学综述旨在评估 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的腰痛手动疗法试验中利益冲突的披露情况，并与外部搜索结果进行比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights potential shortcomings in conflict of interest disclosures within manual therapy trials, urging vigilance regarding transparency when evaluating related research evidence.
items.limitation: 研究范围仅限于 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的针对非特异性腰痛的手动疗法试验。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to manual therapy trials for nonspecific low back pain published between 2000 and 2025.

items.title: Beyond the Diagnosis: An Integrated Perspective on Strategic Dosing in Neurologic Motor Rehabilitation. A Scoping Review and Collaborative Viewpoint.
items.summary: A scoping review and collaborative viewpoint explored strategic dosing in neurologic motor rehabilitation, suggesting a mechanism-based framework for therapeutic reasoning, dosing, and longitudinal adaptation, noting a distinction between higher-intensity approaches for non-progressive conditions and conservative strategies for progressive conditions.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述和专家观点提出了一种神经运动康复中的“策略性剂量”框架，它提示你需要跳出诊断协议的限制，更关注基于机制的治疗推理和剂量调整。
items.titleZh: 超越诊断：神经运动康复中策略性剂量的综合视角——范围综述与合作观点
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述和合作观点探讨了神经运动康复中的策略性剂量，提出了一个基于机制的治疗推理、剂量和纵向适应框架，并区分了针对非进展性疾病的高强度方法和进展性疾病的保守策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review and expert viewpoint propose a "strategic dosing" framework in neuromotor rehabilitation, suggesting you move beyond diagnostic protocol limitations and focus more on mechanism-based therapeutic reasoning and dose adjustment.
items.limitation: 本综述的证据合成不足以形成标准化的剂量参数。
items.limitationEn: The evidence synthesis in this review is insufficient to establish standardized dosing parameters.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Personalized Robot-Assisted Trunk and Lower Limb Rehabilitation in Patients with Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=40) found that adding individualized robot-assisted trunk-lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improved Functional Ambulatory Category (FAC) in chronic stroke patients at 3 months, compared to conventional rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，能显著改善慢性卒中患者的步行功能。考虑将这类技术整合到你的康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢康复对慢性卒中患者的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=40）发现，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，在3个月时能显著改善慢性卒中患者的功能性步行分类（FAC）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that adding personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves walking function in chronic stroke patients. Consider integrating such technologies into your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且随访期仅为3个月。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size and a follow-up period of only 3 months.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 142 articles found that physical exercise may be effective for cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease, though optimal dosage for targeted outcomes remains unclear.
items.curatedReason: 运动确实可能改善阿尔茨海默病老年患者的认知功能。但这份纳入了 142 篇文章的系统综述也明确指出，在将运动作为常规干预手段时，最佳剂量和具体运动类型仍是我们需要深究的问题。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年人的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含142篇文章的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，体育锻炼可能对阿尔茨海默病老年人的认知功能有效，但针对特定结局的最佳剂量尚不明确。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise may indeed improve cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease. However, this systematic review of 142 articles makes it clear that optimal dosage and specific exercise types remain critical questions we need to address before incorporating exercise as a routine intervention.
items.limitation: 本综述未能确定运动干预对阿尔茨海默病患者的最佳剂量。
items.limitationEn: This review failed to determine the optimal dosage of exercise interventions for patients with Alzheimer's disease.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: A systematic review of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for post-stroke mobility prognostication.
items.summary: A systematic review identified early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers measured <14 days post-stroke that predict mobility outcomes up to 24 months, providing insights into prognostic capacity.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述梳理了卒中后早期移动能力预测的神经影像和神经生理生物标志物，为你制定个性化的康复计划和设定目标提供了更精准的证据。
items.titleZh: 卒中后移动能力预后早期神经影像学与神经生理学生物标志物的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述识别了卒中后14天内测量、能预测长达24个月移动结局的早期神经影像学和神经生理学生物标志物，为预后能力提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review consolidates neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for early post-stroke mobility prognostication, offering more precise evidence to guide your personalized rehabilitation planning and goal setting.
items.limitation: 研究未提供合并的效应量或不同生物标志物之间的比较。
items.limitationEn: The review did not provide pooled effect sizes or comparisons between different biomarkers.

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=50) found that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the elastic coefficient of the dermis at day 9, compared to 0% tension taping, in patients with limb oedema.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，具有25%张力的肌内效贴布能显著减少重度依赖患者的肢体水肿。这提示你可以在临床实践中，考虑将适度张力的肌内效贴布作为水肿管理的一个辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布对重度依赖患者肢体水肿的疗效：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=50）发现，在肢体水肿患者中，与0%张力贴布相比，25%张力肌内效贴布在第9天显著降低了真皮弹性系数。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that kinesiology taping with 25% tension significantly reduces limb edema in severely hyper-dependent patients. This suggests you can consider using kinesiology taping with moderate tension as an adjunct in edema management in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注了短期效应，缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on short-term effects, lacking long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Survey on stroke rehabilitation in Europe (SUSTAIN-EU) to evaluate European stroke rehabilitation services.
items.summary: A cross-sectional online survey assessed the organization and delivery of post-stroke rehabilitation services across 30 European countries, revealing both commonalities and disparities in service provision, with stroke unit rehabilitation available in 90% of countries.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对欧洲卒中康复服务的调查提供了不同国家康复服务组织和交付的现状概览，你可以此为参照，审视你所在机构的服务模式是否与国际实践接轨。
items.titleZh: 欧洲卒中康复调查 (SUSTAIN-EU) 评估欧洲卒中康复服务
items.summaryZh: 一项针对30个欧洲国家卒中后康复服务组织和交付的在线横断面调查显示，服务提供存在共性和差异，其中90%的国家提供卒中单元康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of stroke rehabilitation services in Europe offers an overview of service organization and delivery across various countries, providing a benchmark for you to assess how your institution's service model aligns with international practices.
items.limitation: 该调查依赖于受访者的自我报告，可能存在主观偏差。
items.limitationEn: The survey relies on self-reported data from respondents, which may introduce subjective bias.

items.title: Direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behaviour in hospitals: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and synthesized direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behavior at ward level, highlighting the need for greater methodological clarity to support physical activity interventions.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述阐明了住院患者运动行为的直接观察方法，统一了评估策略，有助于你更准确地评估和推广住院患者的早期活动干预。
items.titleZh: 住院患者运动行为直接观察方法：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述综合了病房层面评估住院患者运动行为的直接观察方法，强调了提升方法学清晰度以支持物理活动干预的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies direct observation methods for inpatient movement, unifying assessment strategies to help you more accurately evaluate and promote early mobilization interventions in hospitalized patients.
items.limitation: 本综述未提供具体观察工具的优劣或验证性数据。
items.limitationEn: The review does not provide specific advantages, disadvantages, or validation data for observation tools.

items.title: Foot-Targeted Rehabilitation for Pronation-Related Anterior Knee Pain: A Two-Phase Case-Control Study and Single-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Manual Therapy Versus Neuromuscular Training Each With Augmented Low-Dye Taping.
items.summary: This study characterized functional and biomechanical differences in AKP patients with pronated feet and compared foot-targeted manual therapy and neuromuscular training with augmented low-dye taping against routine care, showing comparable short-term effectiveness.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究将脚部生物力学与前膝痛（AKP）联系起来，并比较了两种脚部定向的物理治疗方案（手法治疗+低弓足贴扎 vs. 神经肌肉训练+低弓足贴扎）与常规治疗的短期疗效，为治疗Pronation相关AKP提供了基于证据的方案选择。
items.titleZh: 针对旋前性前膝痛的足部康复：手动疗法与神经肌肉训练结合低弓足贴扎的两阶段病例对照研究与单盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 该研究描述了旋前足患者前膝痛（AKP）的功能和生物力学差异，并比较了结合低弓足贴扎的手动疗法和神经肌肉训练方案与常规护理的短期疗效，结果显示具有相似的短期有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study links foot biomechanics to anterior knee pain (AKP) and compares the short-term effectiveness of two foot-targeted physiotherapy regimens (Manual Therapy + Augmented Low-Dye Taping vs. Neuromuscular Training + ALDT) against routine care, providing evidence-based options for treating pronation-related AKP.
items.limitation: 研究为序列两阶段设计，且仅评估了短期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The study employed a sequential two-phase design and evaluated only short-term effectiveness.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of In-Clinic Rehabilitation vs. Home-Based Telerehabilitation for Adults with MS in the Deep South: The TEAMS Cluster Randomized Trial.
items.summary: The TEAMS cluster randomized trial found that a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program for adults with MS was similarly effective whether delivered in-clinic (DirectCAM) or at home via telerehabilitation (TeleCAM).
items.curatedReason: TEAMS这项大型RCT表明，针对MS患者的12周补充与替代医学（CAM）康复项目，无论是诊所内（DirectCAM）还是居家远程（TeleCAM）提供，效果都相似。这意味着你可以更灵活地为MS患者安排CAM康复，居家远程治疗同样有效，尤其适合行动不便的患者。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化（MS）成人患者的院内康复 vs.居家远程康复：TEAMS簇随机试验
items.summaryZh: TEAMS簇随机试验发现，对多发性硬化（MS）成人患者进行的为期12周的补充与替代医学（CAM）计划，无论是在诊所（DirectCAM）还是通过居家远程康复（TeleCAM）进行，其有效性相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TEAMS large RCT shows that a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program for adults with MS is similarly effective whether delivered in-clinic (DirectCAM) or at home via telerehabilitation (TeleCAM). This means you can more flexibly arrange CAM rehabilitation for MS patients; home-based telerehabilitation is just as effective, especially for those with mobility limitations.
items.limitation: 研究集中在美国深南部地区，且CAM项目的具体内容未详细说明。
items.limitationEn: The study is geographically limited to the Deep South of the US, and the specific content of the CAM program is not detailed.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: This multicenter study determined the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC of the Turkish PFDI-20 in women with PFD post-pelvic floor muscle training, establishing key psychometric properties for clinical use.
items.curatedReason: 该研究为土耳其语版的盆底功能障碍（PFDI-20）量表提供了可靠的响应性、最小可检测变化（SDC）和最小重要变化（MIC）数据，为该地区的盆底肌训练临床实践和研究提供了重要的量化依据。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌训练后土耳其版盆底功能障碍问卷-20（PFDI-20）的响应性、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心研究确定了盆底肌训练后，土耳其版PFDI-20在盆底功能障碍女性中的响应性、最小可检测变化（SDC）和最小重要变化（MIC），为临床应用建立了关键的心理测量学属性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides crucial quantitative data on the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC of the Turkish version of the PFDI-20 for women with pelvic floor dysfunction, offering a vital evidence base for pelvic floor muscle training in that region.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性多中心研究，受限于训练干预为标准化8周。
items.limitationEn: The study is a retrospective multicenter study and is limited by the standardized 8-week training intervention.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: Following subacromial injection, pain relief in subacromial pain syndrome participants immediately and at six weeks altered select shoulder muscle activity during humeral elevation, indicating pain's influence on neuromuscular function.
items.curatedReason: 研究揭示了肩袖注射后疼痛缓解能即时并持续影响肩部肌肉在肩部抬举活动中的激活模式，为理解疼痛与神经肌肉功能的关系提供了线索，但结论的临床影响有限。
items.titleZh: 肩袖注射后缓解可增加肩部疼痛综合征患者特定肩部肌肉的活动
items.summaryZh: 在肩袖注射后，肩袖疼痛综合征患者的疼痛缓解在注射后即刻及六周时均改变了肩部抬举活动中特定肩部肌肉的活动，表明疼痛对神经肌肉功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The study reveals that pain relief post-subacromial injection can immediately and sustainably influence shoulder muscle activation patterns during humeral elevation, offering insights into the pain-neuromuscular function relationship, though clinical impact of findings is limited.
items.limitation: 样本量小（n=21），且存在 EMG 信号变异和记录错误。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (n=21) and issues with EMG signal variability and recording errors were noted.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study assessed the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis, finding them to be reliable and valid for use in clinical settings.
items.curatedReason: 三种运动诱发疼痛（MEP）计算方法在膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者中均显示出良好的信度和效度，提示这些方法可在临床中放心使用。这有助于我们更准确地评估KOA患者的疼痛，从而指导治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛方法的可靠性与构建效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛（MEP）计算方法的可靠性和构建效度，发现它们在临床环境中可靠且有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: These three movement-evoked pain (MEP) calculation methods demonstrate good reliability and validity in individuals with knee osteoarthritis (KOA), suggesting you can confidently use them in clinical practice. This helps us more accurately assess pain in KOA patients and guide treatment plans.
items.limitation: 研究为一项对观察性纵向研究的二次分析，样本人群为特定物理治疗部门的患者。
items.limitationEn: The study is a secondary analysis of an observational longitudinal study, with participants drawn from a specific physiotherapy department.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and synthesized characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups and definitions of abnormal gait following stroke, highlighting the need for individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述清晰地梳理了卒中后步态模式亚组的现有特征和异常步态的定义，为理解和个性化干预提供了基础，但缺乏新的临床实践改变。
items.titleZh: 卒中后分型步态模式亚组特征与异常步态定义：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并整合了卒中后分型步态模式亚组的特征与异常步态的定义，强调了个性化步态训练的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly maps the existing characteristics of gait pattern subgroups and definitions of abnormal gait post-stroke, providing a foundation for understanding and personalized interventions, but lacks direct clinical practice changes.
items.limitation: 本研究为系统综述，不包含新的临床试验数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a scoping review and does not include new clinical trial data.

items.title: Ethics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Stroke Rehabilitation.
items.summary: This commentary discusses the ethical implications and considerations surrounding the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in stroke rehabilitation, emphasizing the need for ethical frameworks and responsible implementation.
items.curatedReason: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）在卒中康复中的伦理考量，强调了在应用新技术时需要关注的伦理框架和潜在挑战，对临床实践具有指导意义。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中的伦理与人工智能（AI）
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章探讨了人工智能（AI）在卒中康复中的伦理影响和考量，强调了在应用新技术时对伦理框架和负责任实施的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article discusses the ethical considerations of artificial intelligence (AI) in stroke rehabilitation, highlighting the ethical frameworks and potential challenges to consider when applying new technologies, offering guidance for clinical practice.
items.limitation: 文章为一篇述评，不包含新的研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This article is a commentary and does not present new research data.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of RCTs evaluated the optimal exercise modality and dose for blood pressure management in middle-aged and older adults, systematically comparing effects across aerobic, resistance, and combined training.
items.curatedReason: 这份高分的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析提供了中老年人血压管理的运动处方细节。有高血压的中老年患者，其运动处方不能再是“多运动”的泛泛建议，你现在可以根据具体收缩压和舒张压目标，直接指导患者选择有氧、抗阻或两者结合，并明确强度和频率。
items.titleZh: 中老年人血压管理中最佳运动方式和剂量：一项基于贝叶斯模型和剂量反应网络 Meta 分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验进行的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统评估了中老年人血压管理中最佳的运动方式和剂量，比较了有氧、抗阻和综合训练等不同运动模式的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-scoring Bayesian network meta-analysis provides detailed exercise prescription for blood pressure management in middle-aged and older adults. For your hypertensive middle-aged and older patients, 'exercise more' is no longer sufficient; you can now directly guide them on aerobic, resistance, or combined training, specifying intensity and frequency based on their systolic and diastolic BP targets.
items.limitation: 尽管是高质量的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析，其结论仍受限于纳入研究的异质性和个体研究的质量。
items.limitationEn: Despite being a high-quality systematic review and network meta-analysis, its conclusions are still limited by the heterogeneity and quality of the included studies.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=28) compared functional versus conventional physiotherapy in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome, finding no significant differences in symptom severity, psychological outcomes, or quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 功能性物理治疗与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征患者的症状、心理结局和生活质量的影响相似，提示功能性干预并非绝对优于传统方法。在临床实践中，可以根据患者个体情况选择或结合两种方法，但不必认为功能性训练是唯一的优选。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗在膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者中对症状、心理结局和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=28）比较了功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者的疗效，结果显示在症状、心理结局和生活质量方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional physiotherapy and conventional physiotherapy show similar effects on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome. This suggests that functional interventions are not necessarily superior to traditional methods. In clinical practice, you can choose or combine approaches based on individual patient needs, rather than exclusively favoring functional training.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=28），可能限制了其统计效力，且未提及长期随访结果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=28), which may limit its statistical power, and long-term follow-up results were not reported.

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored experiences of postgraduate Masters physiotherapy mentees and mentors engaged in telehealth e-mentoring in Canada and compared findings with the UK, identifying its potential for advanced practice capabilities.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制在加拿大和英国的肌骨物理治疗研究生教育中表现出跨文化适用性，为你考虑在继续教育或学生带教中引入远程模式提供了实践基础。尤其在远程执业日益普遍的今天，提前熟悉和参与远程指导能更好地适应未来需求。
items.titleZh: 加拿大和英国肌骨物理治疗研究生教育中远程电子导师制的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大肌骨物理治疗研究生导师与学员参与远程电子导师制的经验，并与英国的情况进行比较，揭示了其在高级实践能力培养方面的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring demonstrates cross-cultural applicability in postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the UK, providing a practical basis for you to consider incorporating remote models in continuing education or student supervision. Especially with the growing prevalence of telehealth practice, familiarizing yourself with and engaging in remote mentoring can better prepare you for future demands.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小且受限于参与者的主观经验报告，难以量化效果或推广至更大人群。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, relying on participants' subjective experiences, which limits the generalizability and quantitative measurement of effects.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training interventions in healthy older adults, supporting its potential role in fall prevention but highlighting variability.
items.curatedReason: 扰动式平衡训练在健康老年人跌倒预防中确实有潜力，这份综述也支持这一点。但要看到其方法学的多样性和不统一，这提示我们在实际应用或设计研究时仍需谨慎，注意其有效性可能因训练方案细节而异。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人扰动式平衡训练的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统地绘制了健康老年人机械诱导扰动式平衡训练干预的方法学特征，支持其在跌倒预防中的潜在作用，但也突出了其方法学的多样性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Perturbation-based balance training shows potential for fall prevention in healthy older adults, and this review supports it. However, recognize the methodological variability; this suggests caution in clinical application or research design, as effectiveness may differ based on specific training protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，侧重于方法学特征的映射而非干预效果的量化评估，因此不能直接提供关于效果的肯定性结论。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review focuses on mapping methodological characteristics rather than quantifying intervention effects, thus not directly providing definitive conclusions on efficacy.

items.title: Systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain: Refining the mechanistic lens.
items.summary: This review explores systemic inflammation as a potential mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain, refining the mechanistic understanding of its therapeutic effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提出运动对慢性腰痛的益处可能由全身炎症介导，深化了我们对运动机制的理解。虽然这不直接改变你的临床干预，但让你能更有依据地向患者解释运动疗法的作用，尤其是在涉及炎症通路的患者中。
items.titleZh: 全身炎症作为运动在慢性腰痛中益处的介质：优化机制视角
items.summaryZh: 该综述探讨了全身炎症作为运动在慢性腰痛中益处的潜在介质，从而深化了对其治疗机制的理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study proposes that systemic inflammation may mediate the benefits of exercise in chronic low back pain, deepening our understanding of exercise mechanisms. While this doesn't directly alter your clinical interventions, it provides a more evidence-based way to explain the role of exercise therapy to patients, especially those with inflammatory pathways.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于现有文献的汇总与推测，可能受到原始研究异质性的影响。
items.limitationEn: As a review and not an original study, its conclusions are based on existing literature synthesis and speculation, potentially influenced by heterogeneity of the original studies.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=14) explored patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management, revealing strong faith in exercise, a desire for clear explanations, and appreciation for clinicians who listen.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了肩袖肌腱病患者对运动疗法的高度信任，并且期望获得清晰的症状解释和个性化的治疗方案。这提醒你在临床实践中，要重视患者的叙述和偏好，将运动疗法作为核心干预，并提供更具共情和定制化的教育。
items.titleZh: “我现在真的只相信运动了”：肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=14）探讨了肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法，结果显示患者对运动疗法高度信任，并渴望清晰的解释和能倾听的临床医生。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights patients' strong belief in exercise therapy for rotator cuff tendinopathy and their desire for clear symptom explanations and personalized treatment. This reminds you to prioritize patient narratives and preferences in clinical practice, center exercise therapy as a core intervention, and provide more empathetic and tailored education.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性设计，样本量小（n=14），且结果基于患者主观叙述，不适合进行量化推断或普遍推广。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (n=14) and relied on subjective patient narratives, limiting quantitative inference and generalizability.

items.title: Impacts of ankle sprain on functional performance in under-20 soccer players: a cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 75 under-20 soccer players found that a history of lateral ankle sprain negatively impacted perceived ankle stability, self-reported function, ankle dorsiflexion, and dynamic balance compared to those without injury history.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究确认了踝关节扭伤史对青少年足球运动员功能表现的负面影响，包括踝关节不稳定、本体感觉缺陷和动态平衡下降。这提示你在评估青少年运动员时，即便没有当前症状，也应主动筛查踝关节扭伤史及其对功能性表现的长期影响，并考虑预防性干预。
items.titleZh: 踝关节扭伤对 20 岁以下足球运动员功能表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 75 名 20 岁以下足球运动员进行的横断面研究发现，有外侧踝关节扭伤史的运动员在踝关节稳定性、自我报告功能、踝关节背屈和动态平衡方面表现更差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study confirms the negative impact of ankle sprain history on functional performance in under-20 soccer players, including ankle instability, proprioceptive deficits, and reduced dynamic balance. This suggests that when evaluating adolescent athletes, even without current symptoms, you should proactively screen for ankle sprain history and its long-term effects on functional performance, and consider preventive interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究是横断面设计，无法建立踝关节扭伤与功能缺陷之间的因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish a causal relationship between ankle sprain and functional deficits, and recall bias may be present.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 61 Greek physiotherapists found 55.7% used manual therapy in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, primarily as an adjunct for joint mobility, with formal training correlating with higher perceived effectiveness for pain reduction and sensory processing.
items.curatedReason: 这项希腊的调查显示，近六成儿科神经物理治疗师会使用手法治疗作为辅助手段，主要用于改善关节活动度。这表明手法治疗在特定场景下仍有其应用价值，但要记住它通常是辅助性干预，且其有效性可能与治疗师的专业培训水平有关。
items.titleZh: 儿科神经物理治疗中当前手法治疗实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项对 61 名希腊物理治疗师进行的横断面调查发现，55.7% 的儿科神经物理治疗师使用手法治疗，主要作为改善关节活动度的辅助手段，且正规培训与其在减轻疼痛和感觉处理方面的感知有效性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Greek survey indicates that nearly 60% of pediatric neurological physical therapists use manual therapy as an adjunct, primarily for improving joint mobility. This suggests manual therapy still has value in specific contexts, but remember it's typically an adjunctive intervention, and its effectiveness may correlate with the therapist's specialized training.
items.limitation: 本研究是针对希腊物理治疗师的横断面调查，结果可能不适用于其他国家或文化背景，且存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey of Greek physical therapists may not be generalizable to other countries or cultural contexts, and is subject to reporting bias.

items.title: Effect of six weeks of ankle stretching exercises on ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A six-week ankle stretching exercise program significantly improved ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and reduced anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation.
items.curatedReason: 踝关节背屈拉伸可能对儿童踝关节旋前引起的膝前痛有效，但需进一步研究明确其长期效果和机制。
items.titleZh: 六周踝关节拉伸运动对儿童踝关节旋前引起的踝关节背屈活动度和膝前痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，为期六周的踝关节拉伸运动显著改善了踝关节旋前儿童的踝关节背屈活动度，并减轻了膝前痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Ankle dorsiflexion stretching may be effective for anterior knee pain caused by ankle pronation in children, but further research is needed to clarify its long-term effects and mechanisms.
items.limitation: 研究随访期较短，且未评估踝关节拉伸对膝前痛的长期影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period and did not assess the long-term impact of ankle stretching on anterior knee pain.

items.title: Differences in the Thoracolumbar Fascia Between Low Back Pain Patients and Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found significant differences in the thoracolumbar fascia characteristics between individuals with low back pain and healthy controls.
items.curatedReason: 腰骶筋膜在腰痛患者和健康个体间的确存在结构性差异，提示筋膜病理是慢性腰痛的重要机制之一。你应当考虑将筋膜作为评估和干预的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: 腰痛患者与健康个体腰骶筋膜的差异：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，腰痛患者与健康个体在腰骶筋膜特征上存在显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Structural differences in the thoracolumbar fascia between low back pain patients and healthy individuals are confirmed, suggesting fascial pathology as a significant mechanism in chronic low back pain. You should consider fascia as a potential target for assessment and intervention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性较高，可能影响荟萃分析结果的统一性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies exhibited high methodological heterogeneity, which may affect the uniformity of the meta-analysis results.

items.title: The effect of SportsMetrics training program on functional performance, landing error, dynamic knee valgus and hamstrings/quadriceps strength in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed the effectiveness of the SportsMetrics training program in improving functional performance, reducing landing errors, dynamic knee valgus, and enhancing hamstrings/quadriceps strength in athletes.
items.curatedReason: SportsMetrics 训练项目在改善运动员功能表现、减少着陆错误、动态膝外翻以及增强蕦绳肌/股四头肌力量方面确有效果。在运动损伤预防和表现提升中，应优先考虑这类综合性训练方案。
items.titleZh: SportsMetrics 训练项目对运动员功能表现、着陆错误、动态膝外翻及平衡肌/股四头肌力量的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析证实，SportsMetrics 训练项目能有效改善运动员的功能表现、减少着陆错误、动态膝外翻并增强平衡肌/股四头肌力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SportsMetrics training program is confirmed to be effective in improving athletic functional performance, reducing landing errors, dynamic knee valgus, and enhancing hamstring/quadriceps strength. You should prioritize such comprehensive training programs in sports injury prevention and performance enhancement.
items.limitation: 部分纳入研究的方法学质量存在差异，可能影响荟萃分析结果的整体稳定性。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality of some included studies varied, potentially affecting the overall stability of the meta-analysis results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of tDCS combined with unstable resistance training on knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength, neuromuscular control, and balance in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: tDCS 结合不稳定抗阻训练可以改善老年人的膝关节肌力、神经肌肉控制和平衡，为临床提供了额外的干预选择。
items.titleZh: tDCS 结合不稳定抗阻训练对社区老年人膝关节肌力及神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合不稳定抗阻训练可以改善社区老年人的膝关节肌力、神经肌肉控制和平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: tDCS combined with unstable resistance training can improve knee muscle strength, neuromuscular control, and balance in older adults, offering an additional intervention option for clinicians.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且受试者为社区居住老年人，结果外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and participants were community-dwelling older adults, so the generalizability of the results requires caution.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Phase-specific relationships between cognitive function and life-space mobility in patients with ischemic stroke: implications for geriatric rehabilitation
items.summary: This study explored phase-specific relationships between cognitive function and life-space mobility in patients with ischemic stroke, highlighting their dynamic reciprocal interaction within the chronic illness trajectory framework.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间移动能力在不同康复阶段的动态关联，提醒你在制定康复方案时，需要考虑认知功能在不同阶段对移动能力的影响。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间移动能力之间的阶段性关系：对老年康复的启示
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间移动能力之间的阶段性关系，强调了其在慢性疾病轨迹框架内的动态互惠作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the dynamic relationship between cognitive function and life-space mobility in ischemic stroke patients across different rehabilitation phases, reminding you to consider the impact of cognitive function on mobility at various stages when developing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，难以建立确切的因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The study's observational design makes it difficult to establish definitive causal relationships, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Multimodal synthesis of neural correlates of motor imagery after spinal cord injury: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review synthesized multimodal neural correlates of motor imagery after spinal cord injury, revealing its potential as a window into retained motor-related neural processes.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤后运动想象的神经关联已得到证据整合，这为设计基于运动想象的神经康复方案提供了神经生理学基础。你可以更深入理解其在康复中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后运动想象神经关联的多模态综合：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述综合了脊髓损伤后运动想象的神经关联，揭示了其作为保留运动相关神经过程窗口的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review integrates evidence on the neural correlates of motor imagery after spinal cord injury, helping you better understand its potential in rehabilitation and providing a neurophysiological basis for designing motor imagery-based neurorehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学存在异质性，可能限制结果的综合强度。
items.limitationEn: Methodological heterogeneity among included studies may limit the strength of the synthesized results.

items.title: Rehabilitative game-based exercise integrated into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial investigated the efficacy of rehabilitative game-based exercise integrated into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, finding potential benefits in engagement and outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 游戏化运动对青少年特发性脊柱侧凸保守治疗的依从性和效果可能有所提升，这个初步 RCT 提供了依据。你可以考虑将技术手段融入康复，以改善患者参与度和治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 康复游戏化运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧凸保守治疗：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机对照试验探讨了康复游戏化运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧凸保守治疗中的效果，发现了在依从性和结果方面的潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Game-based exercise may improve adherence and outcomes in conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, as suggested by this pilot RCT. You can consider integrating technology into rehabilitation to enhance patient engagement and treatment effectiveness.
items.limitation: 作为初步随机对照试验，样本量较小，长期效果和更大范围的适用性需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: As a pilot randomized controlled trial, the sample size is small, and long-term effects and broader applicability require further research.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis found that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program improved plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease patients.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示多学科强化门诊康复项目能改善帕金森病患者的血浆神经丝和肌因子水平，这为理解康复机制提供了生物标志物证据，有助于你优化帕金森病康复方案。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子影响的探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析发现，多学科强化门诊康复项目改善了帕金森病患者的血浆神经丝和肌因子水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program can improve plasma neurofilament and myokine levels in Parkinson's disease patients. This provides biomarker evidence for understanding rehabilitation mechanisms and helps you optimize Parkinson's disease rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究为探索性分析，样本量较小，且未设立对照组，难以确证干预的直接因果效应。
items.limitationEn: The study is an exploratory analysis with a small sample size and no control group, making it difficult to confirm the direct causal effects of the intervention.

items.title: Effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity and their relationship with balance in older adults with a history of falls
items.summary: High-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) improved muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity, and balance in older adults with a history of falls.
items.curatedReason: HD-tDCS 显示出改善有跌倒史老年人肌力、本体感觉和平衡的潜力。可将其视为一种非侵入性神经调节干预手段，但仍需更大型 RCT 验证其临床效用。
items.titleZh: 高清晰经颅直流电刺激对有跌倒史老年人肌力、本体感觉、皮肤敏感性及其与平衡关系的影响
items.summaryZh: 高清晰经颅直流电刺激（HD-tDCS）改善了有跌倒史老年人的肌力、本体感觉、皮肤敏感性及平衡能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: HD-tDCS shows promise in improving muscle strength, proprioception, and balance in older adults with a history of falls. You can consider it a potential non-invasive neuromodulatory intervention, though larger RCTs are needed to confirm its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，且样本量有限，结果可能不具备广泛代表性。
items.limitationEn: This study was a single-center trial with a limited sample size, so the results may not be broadly representative.

items.title: Functional movement screen scores and injury prevalence among collegiate basketball players: a cross-sectional analysis
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the relationship between Functional Movement Screen (FMS) scores and injury prevalence among collegiate basketball players.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了大学生篮球运动员功能性运动筛查（FMS）分数与损伤患病率的横断面关联证据，提示 FMS 可能是运动损伤风险筛查的工具之一，但在临床实践中仍需结合其他评估方法。
items.titleZh: 大学篮球运动员功能性运动筛查分数与损伤患病率：一项横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究调查了大学篮球运动员功能性运动筛查（FMS）分数与损伤患病率之间的关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides cross-sectional evidence linking Functional Movement Screen (FMS) scores with injury prevalence among collegiate basketball players, suggesting FMS as a potential tool for sports injury risk screening, though it should be combined with other assessment methods in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究设计为横断面，无法建立 FMS 分数与损伤风险之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing a causal relationship between FMS scores and injury risk.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Exploratory analysis of the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigated the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究分析了 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术联合治疗儿童发育性髋关节发育不良的年龄分层影响，对你理解不同年龄段手术预后差异有参考价值，但直接康复干预信息较少。
items.titleZh: 3岁年龄分界对联合 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术治疗儿童发育性髋关节发育不良预后影响的探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了以3岁为分界点，年龄分层对联合 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术治疗儿童发育性髋关节发育不良预后的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy for pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip may be influenced by age (with a 3-year cutoff). This offers you a perspective on surgical differences across age groups, but provides limited direct guidance for rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性分析，存在选择偏倚和信息偏倚的风险。
items.limitationEn: The study is a retrospective analysis, carrying risks of selection and information bias.

items.title: AI-assisted exercise prescription in rheumatology: a comparative evaluation of three large language models for personalized APA prescription
items.summary: A comparative evaluation of three large language models for personalized Adapted Physical Activity (APA) prescription in rheumatology showed promising results for AI-assisted exercise prescription.
items.curatedReason: 大型语言模型在风湿病患者个性化 APA 处方中展现出潜力，提示 AI 辅助处方是未来趋势。但在实际应用前，你仍需关注其准确性和临床验证，不能盲目采纳。
items.titleZh: 风湿病学中 AI 辅助运动处方：三种大型语言模型个性化适应性体育活动处方的比较评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对三种大型语言模型在风湿病患者个性化适应性体育活动（APA）处方中的比较评估显示，AI 辅助运动处方前景可观。
items.curatedReasonEn: Large language models show promise in personalized APA prescription for rheumatology patients, suggesting AI-assisted prescribing is a future trend. However, before clinical application, you must still pay attention to its accuracy and clinical validation, and not adopt it blindly.
items.limitation: 研究主要基于模型生成，缺乏真实患者的临床试验验证其效果和安全性。
items.limitationEn: The study is primarily based on model generation and lacks clinical trial validation of its effectiveness and safety in real patients.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Mepivacaine Provides Greater Short-Term Relief Than Dry Needling and Local Lidocaine for Myofascial Pain: Study
items.summary: A study reported that mepivacaine provided greater short-term relief for myofascial pain compared to dry needling and local lidocaine injections.
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻报道的研究指出，布比卡因在短期疼痛缓解方面优于干针和利多卡因，为你提供了不同治疗手段效果的比较信息，但在实践中仍需综合考虑长期效果和患者偏好。
items.titleZh: 研究：布比卡因在肌筋膜疼痛短期缓解方面优于干针和局部利多卡因
items.summaryZh: 一项研究报告称，布比卡因在肌筋膜疼痛的短期缓解效果上优于干针疗法和局部利多卡因注射。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mepivacaine reportedly provides greater short-term relief for myofascial pain compared to dry needling and local lidocaine injections. This offers you comparative information on treatment efficacy, but in clinical practice, you should still consider long-term effects and patient preferences.
items.limitation: 该报道源自第三方新闻平台，缺乏对原始研究设计和方法学细节的深入披露，信息可能不完整。
items.limitationEn: This report originates from a third-party news platform, lacking in-depth disclosure of the original study's design and methodological details, which may lead to incomplete information.

items.title: Latent profile analysis of health literacy in elderly patients after PCI
items.summary: A latent profile analysis identified distinct health literacy profiles among elderly patients after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), highlighting heterogeneity in their understanding and engagement with health information.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过潜在剖面分析揭示了 PCI 术后老年患者健康素养的不同模式，为你理解此类患者的异质性提供了视角，但与物理治疗直接相关的干预信息较少。
items.titleZh: PCI 术后老年患者健康素养的潜在剖面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项潜在剖面分析识别出经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）术后老年患者不同的健康素养模式，凸显了他们在理解和参与健康信息方面的异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Distinct health literacy profiles exist among elderly patients after PCI, as revealed by this latent profile analysis, highlighting their heterogeneity. This offers you a perspective on individual differences in this patient group, but direct physical therapy intervention information remains limited.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法揭示健康素养模式随时间的变化及其对长期结局的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study has a cross-sectional design, which limits its ability to reveal changes in health literacy patterns over time and their impact on long-term outcomes.

items.title: Associations of motor recovery and perceived social support with participation-related outcomes in chronic stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 40 chronic stroke survivors found that both motor recovery and perceived social support are associated with participation-related outcomes, with varying impacts on different domains such as life satisfaction and health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 运动功能恢复和社会支持对卒中患者的参与度均有积极影响，但两者对不同参与结局的影响程度和模式有异。在评估和干预时，你需要细化目标，考虑社会支持干预对生活满意度等主观指标的独特价值。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中患者运动功能恢复和社会支持与参与度相关结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项对 40 名慢性卒中幸存者的横断面研究发现，运动功能恢复和感知的社会支持均与参与度相关结局相关，但对生活满意度和健康相关生活质量等不同领域的影响存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both motor recovery and social support positively influence participation outcomes in stroke survivors, but their impact varies across different domains of participation. When assessing and intervening, you need to refine your goals and consider the unique value of social support interventions for subjective outcomes like life satisfaction.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which precludes the establishment of causality.

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a randomized controlled trial of a patient-centred transition program for stroke survivors and their caregivers-P-NAVISTROKE study.
items.summary: This pilot randomized controlled trial with 28 stroke survivors and 9 caregivers found a patient-centered transition program combining an information platform and case manager follow-up to be feasible and acceptable, addressing psychosocial recovery during hospital-to-home transition.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，以患者为中心的卒中居家过渡计划是可行且可接受的。虽然目前主要验证可行性，但它提示你，在卒中患者出院到居家期间，结合信息平台和个案管理师随访的模式可能有效缓解其心理社会恢复中的支持不足。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者及其照护者的以患者为中心的过渡计划——P-NAVISTROKE 研究的随机对照试验可行性与可接受性
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 28 名卒中幸存者和 9 名照护者的试点随机对照试验发现，结合信息平台和个案管理师随访的以患者为中心的过渡计划是可行且可接受的，旨在解决卒中患者出院回家期间的心理社会恢复问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT demonstrates that a patient-centered stroke transition program to home is feasible and acceptable. While primarily validating feasibility, it suggests that a model combining an information platform with case manager follow-up could effectively address the lack of psychosocial support for stroke survivors during their hospital-to-home transition.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索可行性和可接受性的试点研究，样本量小（28 名卒中幸存者和 9 名照护者），未评估临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study exploring feasibility and acceptability with a small sample size (28 stroke survivors and 9 caregivers), and did not evaluate clinical efficacy.

items.title: Musculoskeletal impairments associated with migraine in young adults: a case-control study.
items.summary: A case-control study of 140 university students found associations between migraine and reduced core and cervical muscle endurance, as well as altered craniovertebral angle, after adjusting for age, sex, and BMI.
items.curatedReason: 这项病例对照研究支持了偏头痛与颈部肌肉耐力下降及姿势异常的关联。对于年轻偏头痛患者，评估并处理颈椎肌骨功能障碍是一个值得整合到康复方案中的思路。
items.titleZh: 青年偏头痛患者的肌肉骨骼功能障碍：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 140 名大学生的病例对照研究发现，在调整年龄、性别和 BMI 后，偏头痛与核心肌群和颈部肌肉耐力下降以及颅椎角异常存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study supports the association between migraine and reduced cervical muscle endurance and postural alterations. For young adults with migraine, assessing and addressing cervical musculoskeletal dysfunction is a promising approach to integrate into rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 病例对照设计无法确立因果关系，且研究人群仅限于大学生，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The case-control design cannot establish causality, and the study population is limited to university students, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Twenty years of the fitness and mobility exercise (FAME) program for people post-stroke: a multi-data source evaluation of implementation using the RE-AIM framework.
items.summary: A multi-data source evaluation using the RE-AIM framework assessed the real-world implementation and dissemination of the FAME program for stroke recovery, identifying 35 publications and uptake outside Canada.
items.curatedReason: 虽然 FAME 项目在社区中推广了 20 年，但这项评价首次量化了其在现实世界中的实施情况，为跨国推广提供了参照。
items.titleZh: 脑卒中后健身与活动能力训练（FAME）项目二十年：基于 RE-AIM 框架的多源数据实施评估
items.summaryZh: 一项基于 RE-AIM 框架的多数据源评估，考察了脑卒中后健身与活动能力训练（FAME）项目的现实世界实施和推广情况，共识别出 35 篇相关出版物，显示了在加拿大以外地区的推广情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: While the FAME program has been promoted in communities for 20 years, this evaluation quantifies its real-world implementation for the first time, offering a reference for international dissemination.
items.limitation: 研究依赖多数据源，包括文献计量和下载数据，实际接受干预的患者数量和依从性未明确统计。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on multiple data sources, including bibliometrics and download data; the actual number of patients receiving intervention and adherence are not clearly quantified.

items.title: Exploring readiness to patient-centered goal-setting in stroke Rehabilitation-A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study including interviews with stroke survivors, caregivers, and physiotherapists found that patient-centered goal-setting in stroke rehabilitation is often clinician-led with limited survivor/caregiver involvement, identified barriers, and communication challenges.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究明确指出，目前的卒中康复中，以患者为中心的自主目标设定仍受限，常为临床医生主导，凸显了提高患者参与度的迫切需求。
items.titleZh: 探索卒中康复中以患者为中心的目标设定的准备度——一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项包含对卒中幸存者、照护者和物理治疗师的访谈的定性研究发现，卒中康复中以患者为中心的目标设定常由临床医生主导，幸存者/照护者参与有限，并识别了相关障碍和沟通挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study clearly indicates that patient-centered autonomous goal-setting remains limited in current stroke rehabilitation, often clinician-led, highlighting an urgent need to improve patient involvement.
items.limitation: 研究主要依赖患者、照护者和物理治疗师的访谈，结果的普适性受样本量和定性分析方法影响。
items.limitationEn: The study relies primarily on interviews with patients, caregivers, and physiotherapists; the generalizability of the findings is influenced by sample size and qualitative analysis methods.

items.title: Effectiveness of Telerehabilitation Versus Conventional Rehabilitation on Motor Function and Activities of Daily Living After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of four RCTs (N=226) found telerehabilitation to be non-inferior to conventional physiotherapy for improving motor function (Fugl-Meyer Assessment) and activities of daily living (Barthel Index) in stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 针对卒中后运动功能和日常生活活动能力的远程康复与传统康复的系统综述显示两者效果非劣效。这意味着你可以放心将远程康复纳入卒中患者的康复路径，特别是在无法进行面对面治疗时。
items.titleZh: 卒中后远程康复与传统康复对运动功能和日常生活活动能力影响的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入四项随机对照试验（N=226）的系统综述发现，远程康复在改善卒中患者的运动功能（Fugl-Meyer 评定）和日常生活活动能力（Barthel 指数）方面，与传统物理治疗效果非劣效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review shows non-inferiority between telerehabilitation and conventional rehabilitation for motor function and ADLs after stroke. You can confidently integrate telerehabilitation into stroke recovery pathways, especially when in-person therapy isn't feasible.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入四项研究，样本量为226名参与者，研究数量和总样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: The review included only four trials with a total of 226 participants, suggesting limited statistical power.

items.title: Effects of Fingertip Vibrotactile Stimulation on Postural Control in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Comparison Across Age Groups
items.summary: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improved postural control, measured by center of pressure velocity and area, in 348 community-dwelling older adults across young-old (65-74), old-old (75-84), and oldest-old (≥85) age groups.
items.curatedReason: 指尖振动触觉刺激有望改善老年人的姿势控制，但不同年龄段老年人的具体效果有待进一步细化。对年老和最年老群体的干预设计可以考虑这一发现。
items.titleZh: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人姿势控制的影响：跨年龄组比较
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了指尖振动触觉刺激对348名社区老年人（65-74岁、75-84岁、≥85岁）姿势控制的影响，发现刺激能改善重心速度和区域，但不同年龄组差异尚不明确。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation shows promise for improving postural control in older adults, though specific effects across different age groups need refinement. Consider this finding when designing interventions for old-old and oldest-old cohorts.
items.limitation: 这是一项在medRxiv发布的预印本研究，尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a preprint study published on medRxiv and has not yet undergone peer review.

items.title: Association of the GAP score and roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis explored the association of the GAP score and Roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery.
items.curatedReason: GAP评分和Roussouly分类算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后的长期患者报告结局之间存在关联。这意味着在术前评估和风险分层时，你可以考虑这些评分工具来预测患者的长期康复效果。
items.titleZh: GAP评分和Roussouly分类算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局的关联：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析探讨了GAP评分和Roussouly分类算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: An association exists between GAP score, Roussouly-based algorithms, and long-term patient-reported outcomes after adult spinal deformity surgery. This suggests you can consider these scoring tools during preoperative assessment and risk stratification to predict long-term rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项系统综述和荟萃分析，结论基于现有研究，可能受纳入研究质量和异质性影响。
items.limitationEn: As a systematic review and meta-analysis, its conclusions are based on existing studies and may be influenced by the quality and heterogeneity of included research.

items.title: The relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients: a retrospective cross-sectional study
